items.title: Hepatocyte-derived exosomal miR-122 mediates liver-to-brain crosstalk and neuroinflammation in alcohol-exposed Alzheimer's disease mice.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Veronika Brezani; Marti Ortega-Ribera; Neda Rezagholizadeh; Radhika Joshi; Viliam Brezani; Mrigya Babuta; Bruna de Araujo Cardoso Dos Santos; Adam Zivny
items.abstract: Neuroinflammation and microglial activation are common features in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and excessive alcohol consumption. Alcohol induces liver damage and inflammation, and altered serum aminotransferases have been reported in patients with AD. Small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) and their cargo are emerging as mediators of intercellular communication in AD and alcohol-induced liver injury. However, the effects of alcohol use on AD progression remain to be elucidated. In this study, we evaluated the effects of repeated binge drinking on the liver and brain in the APP/PS1 mouse model of AD. Alcohol-exposed APP/PS1 mice showed elevated serum alanine aminotransferase levels, indicating liver injury absent in controls, along with increased pro-inflammatory cytokine expression in both liver and brain. Alcohol increased the biogenesis and release of sEVs in AD mice and in mouse hepatocytes. These sEVs were enriched in mature miR-122-5p that is predominant in hepatocytes. In vivo, miR-122-5p was detected in the brain of alcohol-exposed AD mice suggesting EV-mediated miR-122-5p transfer to the brain. Microglial uptake of hepatocyte-derived sEVs was confirmed in vitro. sEVs from alcohol-treated hepatocytes sensitized BV-2 microglia to LPS stimulation, significantly enhancing CCL2, CXCL2, CCL3, and TNF-α production. Transfection of microglia with a miR-122-5p mimic partially recapitulated the pro-inflammatory sensitization by sEVs from alcohol-exposed hepatocytes, which was reversed by miR-122-5p inhibitor delivery. ADAM10, a miR-122-5p target, was reduced in both wild-type and AD brains after alcohol exposure, with cell-specific effects. These results suggest that alcohol-induced hepatocyte-derived sEVs may modulate liver-to-brain signaling via miR-122-5p and contribute to neuroinflammation in AD.

items.abstract_cn: 神经炎症和小胶质细胞激活是阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 和过量饮酒的常见特征。据报道，酒精会引起肝损伤和炎症，并且 AD 患者的血清转氨酶会发生变化。小细胞外囊泡 (sEV) 及其负载物正在成为 AD 和酒精性肝损伤中细胞间通讯的介质。然而，饮酒对 AD 进展的影响仍有待阐明。在这项研究中，我们评估了反复酗酒对 APP/PS1 AD 小鼠模型肝脏和大脑的影响。暴露于酒精的 APP/PS1 小鼠血清丙氨酸氨基转移酶水平升高，表明对照组不存在肝损伤，并且肝脏和大脑中促炎细胞因子表达增加。酒精增加了 AD 小鼠和小鼠肝细胞中 sEV 的生物发生和释放。这些 sEV 富含成熟的 miR-122-5p，其在肝细胞中占主导地位。在体内，在暴露于酒精的 AD 小鼠的大脑中检测到 miR-122-5p，表明 EV 介导的 miR-122-5p 转移到大脑。体外证实了小胶质细胞对肝细胞来源的 sEV 的摄取。来自酒精处理的肝细胞的 sEV 使 BV-2 小胶质细胞对 LPS 刺激敏感，显着增强 CCL2、CXCL2、CCL3 和 TNF-α 的产生。用 miR-122-5p 模拟物转染小胶质细胞，部分重现了来自酒精暴露肝细胞的 sEV 的促炎致敏作用，而 miR-122-5p 抑制剂递送可逆转这种作用。 ADAM10 是 miR-122-5p 的靶标，在酒精暴露后，野生型和 AD 大脑中的 ADAM10 均减少，并具有细胞特异性效应。这些结果表明，酒精诱导的肝细胞来源的 sEV 可能通过 miR-122-5p 调节肝到脑的信号传导，并导致 AD 中的神经炎症。

items.title: The hepatic secretome-microglia axis in huntington's disease: Linking peripheral metabolic dysfunction to neuroinflammation and novel therapeutic opportunities.
items.authors: Gayatri Bisht; Arush Sharma; Harshita Thakur; Vandana Bhatia; Swati Rana
items.abstract: Huntington's disease (HD) is traditionally regarded as a progressive neurodegenerative disorder caused by an expanded CAG repeat in the HTT gene, resulting in selective striatal neuronal degeneration and progressive motor, cognitive, and psychiatric impairment. However, accumulating evidence indicates that HD is a systemic disorder involving profound metabolic, mitochondrial, and immune dysfunction in peripheral organs, particularly the liver. Emerging studies suggest that hepatic mitochondrial dysfunction induced by mutant huntingtin remodels the hepatic secretome through altered secretion of hepatokines, extracellular vesicles, complement proteins, inflammatory cytokines, and metabolic mediators. These circulating factors may disrupt blood-brain barrier integrity, promote microglial immunometabolic reprogramming, enhance complement-mediated synaptic pruning, and amplify chronic neuroinflammation, thereby accelerating neurodegeneration. This review summarizes current evidence supporting the liver-brain axis in HD and discusses how hepatic metabolic dysfunction contributes to central nervous system pathology. Furthermore, we highlight therapeutic strategies aimed at restoring hepatic mitochondrial homeostasis, modulating hepatokines, extracellular vesicles, exosomal microRNAs, and complement signaling to interrupt pathological liver-to-brain communication. Finally, we discuss emerging translational approaches, including multi-omics technologies, engineered extracellular vesicles, gene-editing platforms, and precision medicine, that may facilitate the development of disease-modifying therapies. By integrating peripheral metabolic regulation with central neuroimmune mechanisms, this review presents the hepatic secretome microglia axis as a potential conceptual framework for understanding HD pathogenesis and identifies liver targeted interventions as promising therapeutic opportunities beyond conventional neuron centric strategies.

items.title_cn: 亨廷顿病中的肝分泌组-小胶质细胞轴：将外周代谢功能障碍与神经炎症和新的治疗机会联系起来。
items.abstract_cn: 亨廷顿病 (HD) 传统上被认为是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，由 HTT 基因中的 CAG 重复扩增引起，导致选择性纹状体神经元变性和进行性运动、认知和精神障碍。然而，越来越多的证据表明，HD 是一种全身性疾病，涉及周围器官（特别是肝脏）的严重代谢、线粒体和免疫功能障碍。新兴研究表明，突变型亨廷顿蛋白诱导的肝线粒体功能障碍通过改变肝因子、细胞外囊泡、补体蛋白、炎症细胞因子和代谢介质的分泌来重塑肝脏分泌蛋白组。这些循环因子可能会破坏血脑屏障的完整性，促进小胶质细胞免疫代谢重编程，增强补体介导的突触修剪，并放大慢性神经炎症，从而加速神经退行性变。本综述总结了支持 HD 肝脑轴的当前证据，并讨论了肝代谢功能障碍如何导致中枢神经系统病理学。此外，我们强调了旨在恢复肝线粒体稳态、调节肝因子、细胞外囊泡、外泌体 microRNA 和补体信号传导以中断病理性肝脑通讯的治疗策略。最后，我们讨论新兴的转化方法，包括多组学技术、工程细胞外囊泡、基因编辑平台和精准医学，这些方法可能促进疾病缓解疗法的开发。通过将外周代谢调节与中枢神经免疫机制相结合，本综述将肝脏分泌组小胶质细胞轴作为理解 HD 发病机制的潜在概念框架，并将肝脏靶向干预确定为超越传统神经元中心策略的有希望的治疗机会。

items.title: External hydrocephalus in adult neurocritical patients.
items.journal: Journal of clinical neuroscience : official journal of the Neurosurgical Society of Australasia
items.authors: Pedro Grille; Emiliano Lecor; Pablo Bouzas
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: External hydrocephalus (EH) in adults is an underrecognized clinical entity characterized by CSF circulatory failure and progressive subarachnoid space (SAS) dilation under high intracranial pressure (ICP). Data regarding its incidence, pathophysiology, and management in adult neurocritical care are sparse. OBJECTIVE: To describe the incidence, risk factors and outcome of EH in adult neurocritical patients. METHODS: Prospective study of patients with moderate-to-severe traumatic brain injury (msTBI) or spontaneous subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) admitted to intensive care unit (ICU). Three subgroups ere defined: 1) radiological EH: dilated SAS between two successive CT scans; 2) radiological EH in the context of intracranial hypertension (IH): suspected o confirmed elevated ICP; and 3) radiological EH and invasively documented elevated ICP. RESULTS: A total of 128 patients were included (78 msTBI, 50 SAH). The incidence of radiological EH was 20.3 % (26.9 % in msTBI and 10 % in SAH), while the incidence of radiological EH in the context of IH was 7.8 % (10.3 % in msTBI vs. 4 % in SAH). The median time to EH onset was 4.5. Radiological EH in the context of IH was significantly associated with younger age, refractory intracranial hypertension, surgical intervention, decompressive craniectomy, and prolonged ICU stay. Intracranial hypertension due to EH required external lumbar drainage in 70 %. CONCLUSIONS: The first prospective study on EH adult neurocritical patients is presented. EH presents as a not uncommon and complex driver of secondary neurological deterioration and prolonged hospital resource utilization in adult neurocritical care. Diagnosis requires a high index of suspicion based on clinical and radiological findings. It is associated with refractory intracranial hypertension, generally requiring an external lumbar drainage.

items.title_cn: 成人神经危重患者的外部脑积水。
items.abstract_cn: 背景：成人外部脑积水（EH）是一种未被充分认识的临床实体，其特征是高颅内压（ICP）下脑脊液循环衰竭和进行性蛛网膜下腔（SAS）扩张。有关其发病率、病理生理学和成人神经重症监护管理的数据很少。目的：描述成人神经危重患者 EH 的发生率、危险因素和结果。方法：对入住重症监护室（ICU）的中度至重度创伤性脑损伤（msTBI）或自发性蛛网膜下腔出血（SAH）患者进行前瞻性研究。定义了三个亚组：1）放射学 EH：两次连续 CT 扫描之间扩张的 SAS； 2) 颅内高压 (IH) 背景下的放射学 EH：怀疑或确诊 ICP 升高； 3) 放射学 EH 和侵入性记录的 ICP 升高。结果：总共纳入 128 名患者（78 名 msTBI，50 名 SAH）。放射学 EH 的发生率为 20.3%（msTBI 为 26.9%，SAH 为 10%），而 IH 背景下放射学 EH 的发生率为 7.8%（msTBI 为 10.3%，SAH 为 4%）。 EH 发病的中位时间为 4.5 小时。 IH 背景下的放射学 EH 与年轻、难治性颅内高压、手术干预、去骨瓣减压术和 ICU 住院时间延长显着相关。 EH 引起的颅内高压需要腰椎外引流，70%。结论：首次针对 EH 成人神经危重患者进行前瞻性研究。 EH 是成人神经重症监护中继发性神经功能恶化和医院资源长期利用的常见且复杂的驱动因素。诊断需要根据临床和放射学结果保持高度怀疑。它与难治性颅内高压有关，通常需要腰椎外部引流。

items.title: Choline attenuates lipopolysaccharide-induced neuroinflammation in the BV-2 microglial cell line via the α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor/nuclear factor kappa-B signaling pathway.
items.authors: ZhengLong Xia; DuoGan Wang; XiaoQi Qiu; ShaoWen Huang; YanXiong Wen; YiShuang Huang
items.abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to investigate the potential mechanisms by which choline (CHO) attenuates lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced neuroinflammatory responses in BV-2 microglial cells through network pharmacology-based prediction and in vitro experiments. These neuroinflammatory responses are implicated in the pathophysiology of sepsis-associated encephalopathy (SAE). METHODS: Putative CHO targets were retrieved from PubChem, the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD), and SwissTargetPrediction, while SAE-associated genes were sourced from OMIM and GeneCards. Overlapping targets from both datasets were subjected to protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction, along with Gene Ontology (GO) functional annotation and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment, to identify core candidate genes and key signaling cascades. The predicted outcomes were subsequently verified by in vitro experiments, including cell viability assays, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), immunofluorescence, quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR), and Western blot. RESULTS: An intersection of 672 SAE-associated genes and 109 CHO-responsive genes yielded 24 common targets. Among them, TNF, IL10, IL6, MMP9, and IL1B were identified as potential hub therapeutic targets. KEGG enrichment analysis revealed the involvement of multiple pathways, with the nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-κB) cascade being particularly notable. In cell-based assays, CHO administration reduced the levels of pro-inflammatory mediators (TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6) and concurrently increased those of anti-inflammatory markers (IL-4, IL-10, and CD206). Furthermore, CHO elevated α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (α7nAChR) expression while suppressing IκBα and NF-κB p65 phosphorylation. Treatment with the α7nAChR antagonist methyllycaconitine citrate (MLA) reversed these effects. CONCLUSIONS: CHO may inhibit microglial neuroinflammation and promote anti-inflammatory polarization, potentially via the α7nAChR/NF-κB signaling pathway.

items.title: A TGF-β1-Binding and Stem Cell-Homing Peptide Hydrogel Loaded with BMSC-Exosomes Enhances the Endogenous Repair of Surgically Induced Osteochondral Defects.
items.authors: Weihua Hu; Jun Chen; Feng Yu; Guoqing Yu; Kun Li; Zhilong Chen; Ye Wang; Zi Li
items.abstract: To address the poor self-repair capacity of experimental osteochondral defects and the inefficacy of conventional hydrogels, this study developed a biodegradable peptide hydrogel, Exos@TRM. This study used an acute surgically created osteochondral defect model in rats, which does not fully reproduce experimental cartilage defects or chronic human cartilage degeneration. Based on the RADA16 framework, this hydrogel incorporates a TGF-β1-binding peptide and a stem cell-recruiting motif, and is loaded with exosomes derived from bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs). In vitro experiments demonstrated that Exos@TRM effectively binds TGF-β1, promotes BMSC migration, and enables sustained exosome release for up to one week, thereby facilitating BMSC proliferation and chondrogenic differentiation. In a rat cartilage defect model, Exos@TRM reduced pro-inflammatory M1 macrophages, recruited endogenous TGF-β1 and BMSCs to the injury site, promoted chondrogenic differentiation at week 3, and achieved tissue regeneration resembling natural cartilage with functional mechanical properties by week 8. Mechanistic studies confirmed that the regenerative effects are TGF-β1-dependent, and comprehensive biosafety evaluation revealed no systemic toxicity. This study demonstrates that Exos@TRM achieves significant cartilage repair without exogenous cells or high-dose growth factors through synergistic immunomodulation, localized TGF-β1 recruitment, and stem cell homing, offering a clinically promising strategy for experimental cartilage defects.

items.abstract_cn: 为了解决实验性骨软骨缺损自我修复能力差和传统水凝胶无效的问题，本研究开发了一种可生物降解的肽水凝胶Exos@TRM。这项研究使用了通过急性手术创建的大鼠骨软骨缺损模型，该模型不能完全重现实验性软骨缺损或慢性人类软骨退变。该水凝胶基于 RADA16 框架，包含 TGF-β1 结合肽和干细胞招募基序，并装载有源自骨髓间充质干细胞 (BMSC) 的外泌体。体外实验表明，Exos@TRM有效结合TGF-β1，促进BMSC迁移，并能够持续释放外泌体长达一周，从而促进BMSC增殖和软骨分化。在大鼠软骨缺损模型中，Exos@TRM减少促炎性M1巨噬细胞，将内源性TGF-β1和BMSC募集到损伤部位，在第3周促进软骨分化，并在第8周实现类似于天然软骨的组织再生，具有功能性机械特性。机制研究证实，再生作用是TGF-β1依赖性的，综合生物安全性评估显示没有全身毒性。这项研究表明，Exos@TRM 通过协同免疫调节、局部 TGF-β1 募集和干细胞归巢，无需外源细胞或高剂量生长因子即可实现显着的软骨修复，为实验性软骨缺陷提供了一种临床上有前景的策略。

items.title: Anxiety and depression in adult low-grade glioma patients: risk factors and prognostic value.
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Anxiety and depression are common in patients with glioma, but limited studies focus on these psychological discomforts in patients with adult low-grade gliomas (LGG). AIMS: This study was aimed to assess the prevalence, risk factors as well as prognostic value of anxiety and depression in adult LGG patients. METHODS: A prospective study of 192 patients used mixed methods to measure anxiety and depression before surgery, at 6 months after surgery, and at 12 months after surgery. Analysis was performed using the Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS) and Zung self-rating anxiety/depression scale (SAS/SDS) respectively. Progression-free survival (PFS) was calculated by the survival data of patients. RESULTS: Both the prevalences of anxiety and depression before surgery were higher than those at 6 months or 12 months after surgery in adult LGG patients. In addition, we investigated risk factors and prognostic value of anxiety and depression in patients before surgery. We found that female, epilepsy, hydrocephalus, and larger tumor diameter were independent risk factors of HADS and SAS anxiety before surgery; female gender, epilepsy, hydrocephalus were independent risk factors of HADS and SDS depression. According to the log-rank test, HADS anxiety, SAS anxiety, HADS depression and SDS depression were associated with shorter PFS. CONCLUSIONS: Our study indicated that the prevalences of anxiety and depression were higher before surgery than after surgery in adult LGG patients, and the risk factors and prognostic value of anxiety and depression might be helpful to the early prevention and prognosis improvement in adult LGG patients.

items.abstract_cn: 背景：焦虑和抑郁在神经胶质瘤患者中很常见，但很少有研究关注成人低级别神经胶质瘤（LGG）患者的这些心理不适。目的：本研究旨在评估成年 LGG 患者焦虑和抑郁的患病率、危险因素以及预后价值。方法：一项对 192 名患者进行的前瞻性研究，采用混合方法测量术前、术后 6 个月和术后 12 个月的焦虑和抑郁情况。分别使用医院焦虑和抑郁量表（HADS）和Zung自评焦虑/抑郁量表（SAS/SDS）进行分析。通过患者的生存数据计算无进展生存期（PFS）。结果：成年 LGG 患者术前焦虑和抑郁的患病率均高于术后 6 个月和 12 个月。此外，我们还调查了患者术前焦虑和抑郁的危险因素和预后价值。我们发现女性、癫痫、脑积水、肿瘤直径较大是术前HADS和SAS焦虑的独立危险因素；女性、癫痫、脑积水是HADS和SDS抑郁的独立危险因素。根据对数秩检验，HADS 焦虑、SAS 焦虑、HADS 抑郁和 SDS 抑郁与较短的 PFS 相关。结论：本研究表明成人LGG患者术前焦虑、抑郁的发生率高于术后，焦虑、抑郁的危险因素及预后价值可能有助于成人LGG患者的早期预防和改善预后。

items.title: Neurological and Medical Complications in Brain Tumor Patients. 2026 Update.
items.abstract: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Patients with brain tumors have a plethora of potential complications that arise from both the tumor and its therapeutic management. These complicate clinical management and produce morbidity and occasionally mortality. In this review we discuss the most common neurological and medical complications that include tumor-related epilepsy, vasogenic edema, infection, thromboembolism, endocrine abnormalities and cognitive impairment and its management. This review is an update to the 2020 article by Schiff and Alyahya. RECENT FINDINGS: IDH mutant gliomas cause neuronal hyperexcitability via D-2 -hydroxyglutarate production; use of IDH inhibitors may lower the rate of seizures in this patient population. Pneumocystis prophylaxis with antibiotics has been traditionally recommended with radiation and concurrent temozolomide chemotherapy but newer data suggest no difference in hospitalization or survival. Podoplanin produced by tumor cell releases into the circulation, often via extracellular vesicles, activates platelets and may contribute to venous thrombus formation. Direct oral Anticoagulants (DOACs) are the treatment of choice for venous thromboembolism, with high quality of evidence and a strong recommendation in cancer-associated thrombosis. Though brain tumor patients were underrepresented in clinical trials, retrospective studies support its safety in this population. Brain tumor patients are prone to complications arising from both the tumor and the treatment strategies. Management requires a multidisciplinary strategy with supportive medications including antiseizure medications, corticosteroids, anticoagulants for thromboembolism, and neurocognitive rehabilitation. Early recognition and timely intervention can reduce the morbidity associated with these complications leading to better patient outcomes.

items.abstract_cn: 审查目的：脑肿瘤患者有大量由肿瘤及其治疗管理引起的潜在并发症。这些使临床管理变得复杂并产生发病率，有时甚至导致死亡。在这篇综述中，我们讨论了最常见的神经和医学并发症，包括肿瘤相关癫痫、血管源性水肿、感染、血栓栓塞、内分泌异常和认知障碍及其治疗。这篇评论是 Schiff 和 A​​lyahya 2020 年文章的更新。最新发现：IDH 突变神经胶质瘤通过 D-2-羟基戊二酸的产生导致神经元过度兴奋；使用 IDH 抑制剂可能会降低该患者群体的癫痫发作率。传统上建议使用抗生素预防肺孢子虫，同时进行放疗和替莫唑胺化疗，但最新数据表明住院或生存率没有差异。肿瘤细胞产生的平足蛋白通常通过细胞外囊泡释放到循环中，激活血小板并可能有助于静脉血栓的形成。直接口服抗凝剂 (DOAC) 是静脉血栓栓塞的首选治疗方法，在癌症相关血栓形成方面拥有高质量的证据和强烈推荐。尽管脑肿瘤患者在临床试验中代表性不足，但回顾性研究支持其在该人群中的安全性。脑肿瘤患者很容易出现由肿瘤和治疗策略引起的并发症。治疗需要采用多学科策略和支持性药物，包括抗癫痫药物、皮质类固醇、血栓栓塞抗凝剂和神经认知康复。早期识别和及时干预可以减少与这些并发症相关的发病率，从而改善患者的预后。

items.title: Extracellular Vesicles: Emerging Players in Tumor Progression, Diagnosis, and Therapeutic Applications.
items.authors: Lingyu Kong; Wanying Xu; Yue Niu; Nan Li; Xingye Fan; Xiaolin Wu; Jiaxuan Wu; Yueqiu Jiang
items.abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are emerging as critical players in oncology and also exert vital regulatory effects on exercise-induced muscle injury repair, offering novel insights into tumor biology. Tumor-derived EVs facilitate intercellular communication by carrying bioactive molecules such as proteins and nucleic acids, which reshape the tumor microenvironment and enhance tumor invasion, metastasis, and drug resistance. Conversely, specific subsets of EVs, particularly those derived from dendritic cells or engineered to present tumor antigens, can elicit antitumor immune responses by activating cytotoxic T lymphocytes and facilitating antigen cross-presentation. Clinically, the high stability of EVs in body fluids, coupled with their intrinsic capacity to encapsulate and protect tumor-derived molecular cargo, positions them as robust noninvasive biomarkers for early cancer diagnosis and prognostic stratification, as well as indicators for evaluating muscle recovery status after exercise. Additionally, EVs function as drug delivery carriers, offering advantages like biocompatibility, low immunogenicity, and targeting capabilities. However, challenges remain in EVs isolation, characterization, and scalable production, with inconsistent techniques affecting purity, structure, and biological activity. Moreover, limited understanding of EVs mechanisms, such as their role in immune modulation and drug delivery efficiency, hinders broader clinical translation across oncology and musculoskeletal rehabilitation. Addressing these issues requires advances in standardization, scalable manufacturing, and extensive clinical trials to ensure its safety and efficacy. Despite these challenges, EVs hold immense promise as transformative tools in precision oncology and sports rehabilitation, paving the way for innovative diagnostics, therapies, and improving patient and athletic outcomes in the fight against cancer and exercise-related muscle damage.

items.title_cn: 细胞外囊泡：肿瘤进展、诊断和治疗应用中的新兴参与者。
items.abstract_cn: 细胞外囊泡（EV）正在成为肿瘤学的关键参与者，并且对运动引起的肌肉损伤修复发挥重要的调节作用，为肿瘤生物学提供了新的见解。肿瘤源性EV通过携带蛋白质、核酸等生物活性分子促进细胞间通讯，重塑肿瘤微环境，增强肿瘤侵袭、转移和耐药性。相反，特定的 EV 亚群，特别是那些源自树突状细胞或经过改造以呈递肿瘤抗原的 EV，可以通过激活细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞并促进抗原交叉呈递来引发抗肿瘤免疫反应。在临床上，EV在体液中的高稳定性，加上其封装和保护肿瘤衍生分子货物的内在能力，使它们成为早期癌症诊断和预后分层的强大非侵入性生物标志物，以及评估运动后肌肉恢复状态的指标。此外，EV还可作为药物输送载体，具有生物相容性、低免疫原性和靶向能力等优势。然而，电动汽车的分离、表征和规模化生产仍面临挑战，技术不一致会影响纯度、结构和生物活性。此外，对 EV 机制（例如它们在免疫调节和药物输送效率中的作用）的了解有限，阻碍了肿瘤学和肌肉骨骼康复领域更广泛的临床转化。解决这些问题需要标准化、可扩展制造和广泛的临床试验方面的进步，以确保其安全性和有效性。尽管存在这些挑战，电动汽车作为精准肿瘤学和运动康复领域的变革性工具仍具有巨大的前景，为创新诊断、治疗以及改善患者和运动成果以对抗癌症和运动相关肌肉损伤铺平了道路。

items.title: Post-transplant cyclophosphamide and single-agent tacrolimus as GvHD prophylaxis for allogeneic peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. Comparison between haploidentical and HLA matched/single-allele mismatched donors and impact of lower doses of PTCy.
items.authors: A Esquirol; I Garcia-Cadenas; S Redondo; A Garrido; J Lopez; G Oñate; A Paviglianiti; A C Caballero
items.abstract: Post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PT-Cy) at a standard dose of 50 mg/kg x 2 days (-50) is a standard prophylactic therapy for GvHD in combination with a calcineurin inhibitor and mycophenolate mofetil (MMF). In this retrospective study, we analyzed the results of 321 consecutive patients who received an allogeneic PBSC transplantation. Irrespective of donor type all patients received GVHD prophylaxis based on PT-Cy and single-agent tacrolimus. In non-haploidentical recipients, 2 sequential protocols of PT-Cy were used, with the standard dose in a first cohort and a reduced dose of PT-Cy in a latter cohort. Thus, the study included 103 haploidentical transplants with PT-Cy-50 and 218 recipients of an HLA-matched sibling (MSD), unrelated (MUD) or a 9/10 mismatched unrelated donor (mMUD), of whom 117 received the standard PT-Cy-50 dose and 101 received a reduced dose of PTCy (40 mg/kg x2 days in mMUDs and 30 mg/kg x 2 days in MSD/MUD). Both neutrophil (+22, +21, +19, p 0.001) and platelet engraftment (+27, +23, +17, p 0.001) was delayed in the haplo, non-haplo-50 vs PT-Cy-reduced groups, respectively. In multivariate analysis, there was no difference in the incidence of grade 2-4 aGvHD (p 0.37) or in the incidence of overall (p 0.14) and moderate-to-severe chronic GvHD (p 0.17) between the three groups. At 34 months, there were no differences in OS (p 0.23), GRFS (p0.46), relapse (p 0.15) or TRM (p 0.46). However, there was a statistical trend for higher grade 3-4 aGVHD with reduced-dose PT-CY in non-haplo recipients with a concomitant reduction in the 34-month relapse rate. In conclusion, PT-Cy with single-agent tacrolimus equates the outcomes with any donor type. Although reducing the dose of PT-Cy reduces Cy-induced toxicities, a mild increase in aGVHD may be seen.

items.abstract_cn: 标准剂量 50 mg/kg x 2 天 (-50) 的移植后环磷酰胺 (PT-Cy) 是与钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂和吗替麦考酚酯 (MMF) 联合使用的 GvHD 标准预防性治疗。在这项回顾性研究中，我们分析了 321 名连续接受同种异体 PBSC 移植的患者的结果。无论供体类型如何，所有患者均接受基于 PT-Cy 和单药他克莫司的 GVHD 预防。在非单倍体受者中，使用 2 个连续的 PT-Cy 方案，第一组采用标准剂量，后一组采用减少剂量的 PT-Cy。因此，该研究包括 103 例采用 PT-Cy-50 的半相合移植物和 218 例 HLA 匹配的同胞 (MSD)、无关 (MUD) 或 9/10 不匹配的无关供体 (mMUD) 的受者，其中 117 例接受标准 PT-Cy-50 剂量，101 例接受减少剂量的 PTCy（mMUD 中 40 mg/kg x2 天， 30 mg/kg x 2 天（MSD/MUD）。单倍体、非单倍体 50 组与 PT-Cy 减少组的中性粒细胞 (+22、+21、+19，p < 0.001) 和血小板植入 (+27、+23、+17，p < 0.001) 分别延迟。在多变量分析中，三组之间 2-4 级 aGvHD 的发生率（p < 0.37）或总体（p < 0.14）和中重度慢性 GvHD（p < 0.17）的发生率没有差异。 34 个月时，OS (p < 0.23)、GRFS (p <0.46)、复发 (p < 0.15) 或 TRM (p < 0.46) 没有差异。然而，在非单倍体受者中，减少剂量的 PT-CY 后出现较高级别 3-4 aGVHD 的统计趋势，同时 34 个月复发率降低。总之，单药他克莫司的 PT-Cy 与任何供体类型的结果相同。尽管减少 PT-Cy 剂量可降低 Cy 诱导的毒性，但可能会出现 aGVHD 轻微增加。

items.title: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomic insights into neural substrates of Behavioural dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease.
items.authors: Sahin Mondal; Naveen Sharma; Neeraj Mishra
items.abstract: The transition from bulk-tissue profiling to single-cell and spatially resolved transcriptomics has reshaped our understanding of Alzheimer's disease (AD) from a passive proteinopathy to a coordinated multicellular process spanning the neurovascular unit. However, translating these molecular catalogues into disease-modifying therapies requires a framework that links cellular transitions to neural circuit dysfunction and behavioural abnormalities. This review synthesizes the multicellular landscape of AD, tracing how cell-state-specific remodelling drives network collapse and cognitive decline. Neuronally, selective vulnerability targets projection networks and subclass-specific inhibitory interneurons. Their transcriptional silencing compromises projection pathways, including the entorhinal-hippocampal perforant path, disrupts cortical microcircuits, and underlies episodic memory impairment, hyperexcitability, and executive control failure. This neuronal degeneration is dynamically coupled to reactive glial and vascular remodelling across distinct spatial niches. We examine the non-linear transition of homeostatic astrocytes and microglia into specialized, plaque-associated reactive sub-states, as well as paracrine signalling decay at the neurovascular interface. Compromised capillary tight junctions and the shedding of pericytic survival receptors are proposed to promote blood-brain barrier disintegrity, triggering a feed-forward neuroinflammatory cascade of complement-mediated synaptic pruning. Crucially, we establish a three-tiered hierarchy of evidence, rigorously distinguishing cross-sectional, associative human postmortem findings from inferred functional trajectories in human cellular platforms, and causal, perturbation-based validations in transgenic rodent models. We review how contemporary multi-scale integration-combining single-nucleus transcriptomics with functional electrophysiological platforms and biophysical connectomic modelling-bridges the gap between terminal postmortem signatures and living brain dynamics. Finally, we outline a coordinated translational roadmap illustrating how spatially resolved cell-state networks can guide the development of fluid and imaging biomarkers, support biologically informed patient stratification, enrich clinical trials, and accelerate the development of circuit-restoring precision therapies, thereby providing a mechanistic framework that links cell-state transitions to neural circuit dysfunction, behavioural impairment, and precision medicine in Alzheimer's disease.

items.title_cn: 对阿尔茨海默病行为功能障碍神经基质的单细胞和空间转录组学见解。
items.abstract_cn: 从大块组织分析到单细胞和空间解析转录组学的转变重塑了我们对阿尔茨海默氏病（AD）的理解，从被动蛋白质病转变为跨越神经血管单元的协调多细胞过程。然而，将这些分子目录转化为疾病缓解疗法需要一个将细胞转变与神经回路功能障碍和行为异常联系起来的框架。这篇综述综合了 AD 的多细胞景观，追踪了细胞状态特异性重塑如何导致网络崩溃和认知能力下降。在神经元上，选择性脆弱性针对投射网络和子类特异性抑制性中间神经元。它们的转录沉默会损害投射通路，包括内嗅-海马穿通通路，破坏皮质微电路，并导致情景记忆障碍、过度兴奋和执行控制失败。这种神经元变性与不同空间生态位的反应性神经胶质和血管重塑动态耦合。我们研究了稳态星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞向专门的斑块相关反应亚状态的非线性转变，以及神经血管界面的旁分泌信号衰减。毛细血管紧密连接受损和周细胞存活受体脱落会促进血脑屏障的破坏，引发补体介导的突触修剪的前馈神经炎症级联反应。至关重要的是，我们建立了一个三层证据层次，严格区分横截面、关联的人类尸检结果与人类细胞平台中推断的功能轨迹，以及转基因啮齿动物模型中基于因果扰动的验证。我们回顾了当代多尺度整合——将单核转录组学与功能性电生理学平台和生物物理连接组学模型相结合——如何弥合终末死后特征和活体大脑动力学之间的差距。最后，我们概述了一个协调的翻译路线图，说明空间解析的细胞状态网络如何指导发展……

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Salovum® reduces mortality in isolated severe traumatic brain injury: a randomized phase II trial.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: David Cederberg; Bradley M Harrington; Iain Walker; Ruan Grobler; Nitesh Naranbhai; Ryan K Jacobs; Edward Visse; Niklas Marklund
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Isolated severe traumatic brain injury (TBI) is associated with high mortality and long-term morbidity, especially in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Despite promising results using pharmacological and non-pharmacological therapies in the experimental setting, no clinical trials have demonstrated robust efficacy. We aimed to investigate the effect of antisecretory factor (Salovum®) on 30-day mortality in adult patients with severe TBI. This was a prospective, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial, conducted from September 2017 to February 2022 in a tertiary trauma centre (university hospital) in Cape Town, South Africa (www.clinicaltrials.gov: NCT03339505). The participants were adults with isolated severe TBI (Glasgow Coma Score 6-8), receiving intracranial pressure (ICP) monitoring and neurointensive care. Participants were administered either Salovum® (freeze-dried egg yolk powder enriched with the active compound antisecretory factor) or placebo (freeze dried egg yolk powder) via the nasogastric tubing, dosed according to weight (10-17 g/4 h) and initiated at 32.9 h ± 10.7 h (mean ± standard deviation) post-injury. Study drug or placebo were administered until the ICP monitor was removed or for a maximum of 5 days. The primary outcome of this trial was 30-day mortality and secondary outcome measures were therapy intensity level (TIL) and ICP. One hundred participants aged 18-61 were included, with 49 and 51 patients in the treatment and control groups, respectively. Most patients were male (96%) and the mean age was 33 years. The 30-day mortality rate was 20% in the treatment group and 39% in the control group, yielding a relative risk ratio of 0.52 (confidence interval: 0.271-0.997) and a P-value of 0.040 (chi-square test). TIL and ICP were similar in both groups. No significant adverse events were noted. Antisecretory factor significantly reduced 30-day mortality in severe TBI in an LMIC environment. Further studies investigating the mechanisms by which antisecretory factor act are warranted. The safety, easy administration and marked efficacy of antisecretory factor support exploration in multicentre randomized controlled trials.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Plasma tau-species-positive neuron-derived extracellular vesicles in progressive supranuclear palsy.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Yuanchu Zheng; Huihui Cai; Wenyi Kou; Genliang Liu; Yanlin Wang; Jing Bai; Yingshan Piao; Xuedong Liu
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: The diagnosis of progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) remains challenging, particularly in differentiating it from Parkinson's disease (PD) at early stages. Circulating neuron-derived extracellular vesicles (NDEVs), providing a peripheral window into CNS pathology, might serve as promising biomarkers. A total of 188 participants were recruited from three centres. A discovery cohort [40 PSP patients, 36 PD patients and 31 healthy controls (HCs)] and a multicentre validation cohort (30 PSP patients, 27 PD patients and 24 HCs) were established. NDEVs containing total tau, 4R tau or phosphorylated tau (ptau181, ptau217, ptau231 and ptau396) in plasma samples were analysed using nano-scale flow cytometry. Multivariable logistic regression models were developed in the discovery cohort and strictly validated in the independent cohort using fixed model parameters. In the discovery cohort, the concentrations of tau-, 4R tau-, ptau181- and ptau217-containing NDEVs in PSP patients were significantly higher than those in HCs and PD patients, whereas ptau396-containing NDEVs showed elevation exclusively in PSP compared with HCs (PSP versus HCs: P < 0.001 for tau, P < 0.001 for 4R tau, P < 0.001 for ptau181, P = 0.008 for ptau217, and P = 0.009 for ptau396; PSP versus PD: P < 0.001 for tau, P < 0.001for4R tau, P = 0.029 for ptau181, and P = 0.003 for ptau217). An integrated model incorporating these biomarkers achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.965 (90.0% sensitivity, 96.8% specificity) for distinguishing PSP from HCs and an AUC of 0.963 (87.5% sensitivity, 94.4% specificity) for distinguishing PSP from PD. In the validation cohort, the concentrations of tau-, 4R tau-, ptau181-, ptau217- and ptau396-containing NDEVs in plasma were significantly higher in PSP patients compared with HCs (PSP versus HCs: P < 0.001 for tau, 4R tau and ptau217, P = 0.03 for ptau181, and P = 0.017 for ptau396). Likewise, the concentrations of tau-, 4R tau-, ptau181- and ptau217- were higher in PSP patients than in PD patients (PSP versus PD: P < 0.001 for tau, 4R tau and ptau217, and P = 0.025 for ptau181). The integrated model yielded an AUC of 0.971 for distinguishing PSP from HCs and 0.990 for distinguishing PSP from PD. Notably, in early-stage patients, the integrated model achieved an AUC of 0.987 in differentiating early-stage PSP from PD. These findings indicate that plasma tau-species-containing NDEVs are promising biomarkers for PSP, offering high sensitivity and specificity for distinguishing PSP from both HCs and PD, particularly in early disease stages. Further large-scale, longitudinal studies are warranted to validate these findings fully and explore their role in PSP pathophysiology and progression.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: A spatiotemporal cancer cell trajectory underlies glioblastoma heterogeneity.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Grant de Jong; Fani Memi; Tannia Gracia; Olga Lazareva; Oliver Gould; Georgios Solomou; Alexander Aivazidis; Manas Dave
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Cancer cells show highly heterogeneous and plastic states in glioblastoma, an incurable brain tumour1-5. However, how these malignant states arise and whether they follow defined cellular trajectories across tumours is poorly understood. Here we generated a deep single-cell and spatial multi-omic atlas of human glioblastoma that pairs transcriptomic, epigenomic and genomic profiling of 12 tumours across many regions. We identify that glioblastoma heterogeneity is driven by spatially patterned transitions of cancer cells from developmental-like states towards those defined by a glial injury response and hypoxia. This cellular trajectory regionalizes tumours into distinct tissue microenvironments and manifests in a molecularly conserved manner across tumours as well as genetically distinct tumour subclones. Consistently, using a new deep-learning framework to map cancer cell states jointly with clones in situ, we show that tumour subclones are finely spatially intermixed through glioblastoma tissue microenvironments. We validate this cellular trajectory by using somatic mutation-based hierarchies in vivo and an experimental patient-derived organoid model ex vivo. Finally, we show that this cancer cell trajectory is intimately linked to myeloid heterogeneity and unfolds across regionalized myeloid signalling environments. Our findings define a stereotyped trajectory of cancer cells in glioblastoma and unify glioblastoma tumour heterogeneity into a tractable cellular and tissue framework.

top_journal_neuroscience.title_cn: 时空癌细胞轨迹是胶质母细胞瘤异质性的基础。
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 胶质母细胞瘤（一种无法治愈的脑肿瘤）中的癌细胞表现出高度异质性和可塑性状态1-5。然而，人们对这些恶性状态如何产生以及它们是否遵循肿瘤中确定的细胞轨迹知之甚少。在这里，我们生成了人类胶质母细胞瘤的深度单细胞和空间多组学图谱，该图谱将多个区域的 12 个肿瘤的转录组、表观基因组和基因组分析配对。我们发现胶质母细胞瘤异质性是由癌细胞从发育样状态向神经胶质损伤反应和缺氧定义的空间模式转变所驱动的。这种细胞轨迹将肿瘤划分为不同的组织微环境，并以分子保守的方式在肿瘤以及遗传上不同的肿瘤亚克隆中表现出来。一致地，使用新的深度学习框架与原位克隆联合绘制癌细胞状态，我们表明肿瘤亚克隆通过胶质母细胞瘤组织微环境在空间上精细地混合。我们通过体内基于体细胞突变的层次结构和离体实验性患者衍生的类器官模型来验证这种细胞轨迹。最后，我们表明这种癌细胞轨迹与骨髓异质性密切相关，并在区域化的骨髓信号传导环境中展开。我们的研究结果定义了胶质母细胞瘤中癌细胞的定型轨迹，并将胶质母细胞瘤肿瘤异质性统一到易于处理的细胞和组织框架中。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: P2RX7 drives inflammatory microglia and pathogenic extracellular vesicle secretion in tauopathy.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Victor Bodart-Santos; Arun Reddy Ravula; Yang You; Mohammad Abdullah; Zhi Ruan; Justice G Ellison; Stephanie Radhakishun; Nibedita Basu Ray
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: P2X purinoreceptor 7 (P2RX7), an ATP-gated ion channel, contributes to Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression, but its molecular mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we show that genetic disruption of P2rx7 mitigates brain atrophy, tau accumulation, and cognitive impairment in PS19 mice. Microglia-specific, but not astrocyte-specific, deletion of P2rx7 suppresses tau propagation. Single-cell RNA sequencing identifies a previously unrecognized first-responding microglial state (FRM) with prominent P2rx7 expression. P2RX7 promotes the transition from FRM to an inflammatory microglial state enriched in extracellular vesicle (EV) biogenesis. P2RX7 increases EV loading of tau and of mitochondrial proteins and DNA, which activate cytosolic DNA sensing and interferon signaling in recipient microglia. Tau-containing microglial EVs disrupt neuronal endolysosomal integrity and facilitate endosomal tau escape and phosphorylation. Thus, P2RX7 regulates the FRM branch point, driving inflammatory microglial transition and EV-mediated spread of tau and toxic mitochondrial molecules and highlighting the P2RX7-EV axis as a therapeutic target in AD.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: P2X 嘌呤受体 7 (P2RX7) 是一种 ATP 门控离子通道，有助于阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 的进展，但其分子机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们发现 P2rx7 的基因破坏可以减轻 PS19 小鼠的脑萎缩、tau 蛋白积累和认知障碍。小胶质细胞特异性而非星形胶质细胞特异性的 P2rx7 缺失会抑制 tau 增殖。单细胞 RNA 测序鉴定出先前未被识别的第一反应小胶质细胞状态 (FRM)，其具有显着的 P2rx7 表达。 P2RX7 促进从 FRM 向富含细胞外囊泡 (EV) 生物发生的炎症小胶质细胞状态的转变。 P2RX7 增加 tau 蛋白以及线粒体蛋白和 DNA 的 EV 负载，从而激活受体小胶质细胞中的胞质 DNA 传感和干扰素信号传导。含有 tau 蛋白的小胶质细胞 EV 会破坏神经元内溶酶体的完整性，并促进内体 tau 蛋白逃逸和磷酸化。因此，P2RX7 调节 FRM 分支点，驱动炎症小胶质细胞转变以及 EV 介导的 tau 蛋白和有毒线粒体分子的扩散，并强调 P2RX7-EV 轴作为 AD 的治疗靶点。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Clinical and biochemical characterization of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in a CHCHD10 R15L family.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Justin Y Kwan; Christian I Lantz; Vlad A Korobeynikov; Allison Snyder; Xiaoping Huang; Taryn Haselhuhn; Katherine N Dore; Angelo Madruga
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Familial forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are potential candidates for gene-directed therapies, but many recently identified genes remain poorly characterized. Here, we provide a comprehensive clinical, neuropathological and biochemical description of familial ALS (fALS) caused by the heterozygous p.R15L missense mutation in the gene CHCHD10. Using a cross-sectional study design, we evaluated five affected and nine unaffected individuals from a large seven-generation pedigree with at least 68 affected members. The pedigree suggests a high (68%-81%) but incomplete disease penetrance. Through cloning of the disease allele from distant members of the family, we establish the disease haplotype in the family. Notably, the haplotype was distinct from that of a previously reported p.R15L mutation carrier with ALS, demonstrating that the variant is in a mutational hotspot. The clinical presentation was notable for being highly stereotyped; all affected individuals presented with the rare ALS variant flail arm syndrome (FAS; also known as brachial amyotrophic diplegia or Vulpian-Bernhardt syndrome), suggesting greater involvement of the cervical spinal cord. Consistently, neuropathology from one family member demonstrated substantially increased CHCHD10 protein aggregation and neuronal loss (though absent TDP-43 pathology) in the cervical versus lumbar spinal cord. This FAS phenotype could be captured by a simple timed finger-tapping task, suggesting potential utility for this task as a clinical biomarker. Additionally, through analysis of fibroblast lines from 12 mutation carriers, isogenic induced pluripotent stem cells and a knock-in mouse model, we determined that CHCHD10 with the R15L variant is stably expressed and retains substantial function both in cultured cells and in vivo, in contrast to prior reports. Conversely, we find loss-of-function (LoF) variants are more common in the population but are not associated with a highly penetrant form of ALS in the UK Biobank (31 in controls; 0 in cases). Together, this argues against LoF and in favour of toxic gain-of-function as the mechanism of disease pathogenesis, similar to the myopathy-causing variants in CHCHD10 (p.G58R and p.S59L). Finally, through proteomic analysis of CSF of variant carriers, we identify that CHCHD10 protein levels are elevated approximately 4-fold in mutation carriers, and that affected and unaffected individuals are differentiated by elevation of two neurofilaments: neurofilament light chain (NfL) and peripherin (PRPH). Collectively, our findings help set the stage for gene-directed therapy for a devasting form of fALS, by establishing the likely disease mechanism and identifying clinical and fluid biomarkers for target engagement and treatment response.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Azetukalner in Adults With Focal Seizures: The X-TOLE2 Phase 3 Randomized Clinical Trial.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Jacqueline A French; W Curt LaFrance; Philippe Ryvlin; Eugen Trinka; Vicente Villanueva; Robert Wechsler; Gregory N Beatch; Monica B Dhakar
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Despite more than 30 approved antiseizure medications, many individuals with focal epilepsy continue to experience seizures, indicating a persistent need for novel therapies. OBJECTIVE: To determine efficacy and safety of the novel, potent KV7 channel opener azetukalner for treatment of focal seizures. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This phase 3, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial of azetukalner was conducted over a 12-week double-blind period (November 18, 2022, to February 3, 2026) at 138 sites in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Adults with focal epilepsy experiencing 4 or more focal seizures per month despite stable treatment with 1 to 3 antiseizure medications were enrolled. Data were analyzed using a dataset derived from the database lock dated February 26, 2026. INTERVENTIONS: Participants were randomized 1:1:1 to receive placebo or 15 or 25 mg of azetukalner once daily with the evening meal for 12 weeks with no titration period. Participants completing the double-blind period could enter an open-label extension. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary efficacy end point was median percentage change from baseline in monthly (28-day) focal seizure frequency during the double-blind period for azetukalner vs placebo. Safety and tolerability were assessed by recording treatment-emergent adverse events, changes in clinical laboratory findings, vital signs, and electrocardiogram. RESULTS: Of 607 adults screened, 374 participants (190 [50.8%] female; mean [SD] age, 40.0 [12.9] years) were enrolled, randomized and treated with placebo (125 participants), 15-mg azetukalner (125 participants), or 25-mg azetukalner (124 participants). Participants had a baseline median (IQR) of 12.75 (7.56 to 32.97) seizures per month and had previously tried and stopped a median (IQR) of 5 (3 to 8) antiseizure medications. Most (336 participants [89.8%]) were receiving 2 to 3 concomitant antiseizure medications. The median (IQR) change from baseline in monthly seizure frequency was -10.4% (-39.1% to 8.3%) for the placebo group, -34.5% (-61.6% to -12.3%) for the 15-mg azetukalner group (P < .001 vs placebo), and -53.2% (-77.2% to -28.8%) for the 25-mg azetukalner group (P < .001 vs placebo). Azetukalner was generally well tolerated, and treatment-emergent adverse events were comparable to those observed in the phase 2b X-TOLE trial. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This randomized clinical trial found that azetukalner demonstrated robust, rapid, and durable reductions in seizure frequency with a favorable benefit-risk profile. Treatment with azetukalner resulted in one of the largest median percentage reductions in seizure frequency vs placebo reported to date in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, supporting azetukalner as a promising novel antiseizure medication with significant opportunity to improve clinical outcomes. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05614063.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Mivocabtagene Autoleucel CD19 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy in Stiff Person Syndrome: A Nonrandomized Clinical Trial.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Amanda L Piquet; Anastasia Zekeridou; Usama Gergis; Jonathan Gutman; Saad S Kenderian; Mallory Lowe; Sadie Eggmann; Andrew McKeon
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Stiff person syndrome (SPS) is a progressive, autoimmune neurologic disease characterized by muscle stiffness and painful spasms, leading to substantial disability. Mivocabtagene autoleucel, a fully human, autologous CD19 chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy with CD28 costimulation, showed durable clinical benefit on a named-patient basis in SPS. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of mivocabtagene autoleucel in adult SPS. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This pivotal, single-arm, open-label, nonrandomized phase 2 study enrolled participants from September 2024 to May 2025 at 3 US sites. Individuals aged 18 to 75 years with antibody-positive SPS and inadequate response to immunomodulatory/immunosuppressive therapies as determined by investigators were included. INTERVENTION: Patients received low-dose lymphodepletion (fludarabine, 30 mg/m2/d, and cyclophosphamide, 300 mg/m2/d, for 3 days), followed by a single mivocabtagene autoleucel infusion (1 × 108 CAR T cells). MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Primary end points were the change from baseline to week 16 in the timed 25-ft walk (T25FW) and safety. Secondary end points were modified Rankin Scale score, Distribution of Stiffness Index score, Heightened Sensitivity Scale score, and Hauser Ambulation Index score. Exploratory end points included pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic assessments and biomarkers. RESULTS: Of 27 patients enrolled, 26 (median [range] age, 56.0 [32.0-73.0] years; 16 [61.5%] female) were treated. Median (range) follow-up was 6.5 (4.4-12.2) months. The primary efficacy end point was met, with significant week 16 improvement from baseline in T25FW of a mean of -7.69 seconds (SD, 10.03; 95% CI, -11.74 to -3.64; P < .001) and a median (IQR) of -4.8 (-11.9 to -2.5) seconds (45.6% median improvement); improvement was sustained (median, 44.4%) among 16 of 26 patients who reached the 24-week time point. All secondary efficacy end points showed significant week 16 improvements from baseline (modified Rankin Scale score: mean, -0.8 points [SD, 0.86; 95% CI, -1.1 to -0.4; P < .001], Distribution of Stiffness Index score: mean, -1.5 points [SD, 1.75; 95% CI, -2.2 to -0.8; P < .001]; Heightened Sensitivity Scale score: mean, -3.2 points [SD, 2.01; 95% CI, -4.0 to -2.3; P < .001]; Hauser Ambulation Index score: mean, -1.6 points [SD, 1.13; 95% CI, -2.1 to -1.2; P < .001]). The most common grade 3/4 treatment-related adverse event was neutropenia (5/26 patients [19.2%]). Low-grade cytokine release syndrome and immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome occurred in 24 of 26 patients (92.3%; 10/26 [38.5%] grade 1; 14/26 [53.8%] grade 2) and 3 of 26 patients (11.5%; all grade 1), respectively; all resolved without sequelae. B-cell depletion and clear changes suggestive of immune reset were observed. At last follow-up, all patients remained free of immunomodulatory therapies for SPS. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this nonrandomized clinical trial, a single dose of mivocabtagene autoleucel resulted in immunotherapy-free remissions with a consistent, well-tolerated safety profile, demonstrating a highly effective therapy in antibody-positive SPS with the potential for durable remissions. Long-term follow-up is ongoing. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06588491.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Hemodynamic effects of semaglutide in individuals with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and obesity: a placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Barry A Borlaug; Michael D Jensen; Milton Packer; Yogesh N V Reddy; Tomonari Harada; Fahime Ghanbari; Patrick W Johnson; Rickey E Carter
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: The glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist semaglutide improves symptoms in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) through unclear mechanisms. Here, in this double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, we randomly assigned 81 patients (47 women) with HFpEF and obesity to semaglutide (2.4 mg weekly) or placebo for 52 weeks. The primary outcome was the change in invasively measured pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP), a direct measure of cardiac congestion, during low-intensity exercise. Additional mechanistic outcomes included other hemodynamic measures and hemodynamic HFpEF remission (defined as normal PAWP under conditions of both rest and exercise at 52 weeks). At baseline, PAWP was 17.5 ± 4.3 mmHg at rest and 31.7 ± 5.2 mmHg during exercise. After 52 weeks, the mean change in PAWP during exercise was -9.8 (95% confidence interval (CI): -11.3 to -8.2) mmHg with semaglutide and +0.9 (95% CI: -1.3 to 3.0) mmHg with placebo (estimated difference, -10.6 mmHg; 95% CI: -13.3 to -8.0; P < 0.0001). As compared to placebo, semaglutide also decreased resting PAWP (estimated difference, -7.1 mmHg; 95% CI: -9.8 to -4.4; P < 0.0001), and semaglutide-treated patients were more likely to experience hemodynamic remission (53.7% versus 7.4%, odds ratio = 14.1, 95% CI: 3.0-134.6, P < 0.001). The results from this trial indicate that, in patients with HFpEF and obesity, treatment with semaglutide reduced left heart filling pressures during exercise and at rest and was associated with hemodynamic HFpEF remission in over half of treated patients. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT05371496 .

global_hot_topics.title: Digital workflows for immediate implant placement and soft-tissue management in the esthetic zone: A scoping review.
global_hot_topics.authors: Fernando Mauricio Espada-Salgado; Bogdan Oprea; Stefan Vasile Stefanescu; María Mihaela Iuga
global_hot_topics.abstract: This scoping review mapped clinical evidence on digital treatment workflows for immediate implant placement and peri-implant soft-tissue management in the esthetic zone. Following Joanna Briggs Institute guidance and the PRISMA Extension for Scoping Reviews, Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, PubMed/MEDLINE, LILACS/BVS, Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched for reports published from January 1, 2015, to July 28, 2026, without language restrictions. Digital treatment workflows were defined as digitally acquired data directly informing or executing a clinical treatment step; studies using digital technologies exclusively for postoperative assessment were excluded. Of 1103 records, 589 were screened after removing 514 duplicates. Fifty-nine reports were sought, 55 were assessed, and 43 reports corresponding to 42 studies were included; two linked publications represented one study. The evidence comprised 27 case or technical reports, five case series, five prospective studies, four retrospective studies, and two randomized clinical trials. Study-level categories included integrated digital workflows, static guided surgery with provisionalization, CAD/CAM tissue conditioning, dynamic navigation, and robot-assisted workflows. Applications included prosthetically driven planning, guided placement, immediate provisionalization, customized transmucosal components, emergence-profile transfer, and peri-implant contour support. Most reports described favorable short-term clinical, esthetic, soft-tissue, or radiographic findings. However, predominantly uncontrolled designs, heterogeneous outcomes, and limited long-term follow-up preclude conclusions regarding superiority or predictability. Current evidence supports feasibility and potential clinical utility, whereas dynamic navigation and robot-assisted placement remain emerging modalities requiring comparative investigation.

global_hot_topics.authors: Asma Sghaier; Mohamed Lahbib; Fatma Ezzahra Nejib; Azza Sridi; Moez Sahnoun; Haroun Guermazi; Rim Bahloul; Aida Abdi
global_hot_topics.abstract: Aims: To evaluate postoperative C-reactive protein (CRP) for ruling out anastomotic leakage (AL) after digestive resection in a cohort including several anastomotic sites.Patients & methods: Prospective single-centre diagnostic accuracy study (STARD 2015) of 82 consecutive patients with an unprotected digestive anastomosis (January 2024-August 2025). CRP was measured on postoperative days (POD) 1, 3 and 5. No analysis was formally prespecified. The primary analysis excluded leaks diagnosed on or before POD 5; a strict analysis also excluded four leaks with an undated diagnosis.Results: AL occurred in 12 patients (14.6%). CRP discriminated on POD 3 (area under the curve [AUC] 0.83; 95% CI: 0.71-0.95) and POD 5 (AUC 0.88; 0.78-0.98) but not on POD 1 in the 71 patients with an available value (AUC 0.59). In the primary pre-diagnosis analysis (79 patients, 9 leaks), an exploratory, data-derived POD 5 cutoff of 127 mg/L had a sensitivity of 77.8% (40.0-97.2) and a negative predictive value of 96.4% (87.7-99.6); in the strict analysis (75 patients, 5 leaks), sensitivity was 80.0% and NPV 98.2%. In the full cohort, sensitivity was 83.3% (apparent) and 76.5% (optimism-corrected). Both false negatives followed gastric resection.Conclusion: A low POD 5 CRP makes AL unlikely, particularly after non-gastric resection, but these data-derived thresholds are exploratory, do not support any change in discharge practice and require external validation. After an operation in which part of the digestive tract is removed and the two ends are joined, the join can leak. A leak is dangerous, but in its first days it is hard to tell apart from normal recovery. We studied a simple blood test, C-reactive protein (CRP), which rises with inflammation, by following 82 patients operated on in one Tunisian hospital between January 2024 and August 2025; 12 developed a leak. On the day after surgery, CRP was high in everyone. By the fifth day, it had fallen in most patients who healed well but stayed high in most of those who leaked. A low value on day 5 made a leak unlikely, especially after bowel surgery, but was less reliable after stomach surgery. Because the study was small and the cutoff values were calculated from the same patients, they must be confirmed in larger studies; on their own, these results do not support any change in when patients go home or whether a scan is performed. The test should always be combined with the doctor’s examination.

global_hot_topics.title: Extended DNA damage-induced G2/M arrests lead to aberrant mitoses through accumulation of securin.
global_hot_topics.authors: Anton Dubenko; Marah Jnied; Oleksii Kotenko; Svetlana Makovets
global_hot_topics.abstract: The stochastic nature of DNA damage dictates various scenarios of stress survival among different cells. We used time-lapse microscopy to perform single-cell level analyses of yeast populations with double-stranded DNA breaks and nonfunctional telomeres. Activation of the DNA damage signalling resulted in a broad distribution in the duration of G2/M arrests. Strikingly, the longer arrests correlated with aberrant mitoses caused by miscoordination of nuclear division and cytokinesis, leading to cell death. Chk1-dependent phosphorylation of Pds1 (securin), an inhibitor of sister chromatid separation in mitosis, was responsible for this phenomenon. Securin progressively accumulated during G2/M arrests, leading to grossly delayed or missed nuclear divisions. This phenotype could be suppressed by slowing down the progression of mitotic exit via LTE1 deletion or by lowering securin levels. Our results demonstrate that in cells taking too long to complete DNA repair, the DNA damage checkpoint promotes aberrant mitoses and cell death, thereby eliminating cells with a higher chance of genomic instability.

global_hot_topics.title: Stem cells for hepatic regeneration: Evaluating mechanisms, sources, and clinical outcomes.
global_hot_topics.authors: Narges Dastmalchi; Reza Rahbarghazi; Abolfazl Barzegari; Reza Safaralizadeh; Behzad Mansoori; Seyed Mahdi Banan Khojasteh; Khalil Hajiasgharzadeh
global_hot_topics.abstract: Despite rapid advances in regenerative medicine, the clinical translation of stem cell-based therapies for end-stage liver disease remains limited. These approaches seek to promote hepatic repair through cell replacement, paracrine signaling, and immunomodulation, but differ substantially in their mechanisms, functional capabilities, and translational readiness. The distinctive contribution of this review is a mechanism-based and translation-oriented framework that links the biological properties of different stem-cell sources to the requirements for clinical application. We critically compare mesenchymal stem cells, embryonic stem cells, induced pluripotent stem cells, hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells, and liver-resident progenitors according to their predominant regenerative mechanisms, differentiation capacity, immunogenicity, safety, manufacturing feasibility, and clinical evidence. Particular attention is given to distinguishing direct hepatocyte replacement from paracrine support and stimulation of endogenous repair, while separating preclinical findings from evidence obtained in human studies. We also examine MSC-derived extracellular vesicles as an emerging cell-free approach and assess how organoid-based differentiation, three-dimensional encapsulation, and scalable bioreactor systems may address limitations in hepatocyte maturation and functional stability. Importantly, hepatocyte-marker expression is distinguished from mature metabolic function when evaluating the therapeutic potential of stem-cell-derived hepatic cells. By integrating these biological and engineering considerations with product heterogeneity, tumorigenic risk, manufacturing reproducibility, and the need for validated, mechanism-linked potency assays, this review identifies the principal barriers to clinical translation. Rather than providing a descriptive catalog of therapeutic platforms, it offers a comparative framework for evaluating how regenerative mechanisms, functional maturity, and manufacturing constraints shape the clinical readiness of stem cell-based strategies for hepatic regeneration.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 尽管再生医学取得了快速进展，但基于干细胞的终末期肝病疗法的临床转化仍然有限。这些方法试图通过细胞替代、旁分泌信号传导和免疫调节来促进肝脏修复，但它们的机制、功能能力和转化准备情况有很大不同。该综述的独特贡献是建立了一个基于机制和翻译导向的框架，将不同干细胞来源的生物学特性与临床应用的要求联系起来。我们根据间充质干细胞、胚胎干细胞、诱导多能干细胞、造血干/祖细胞和肝脏祖细胞的主要再生机制、分化能力、免疫原性、安全性、制造可行性和临床证据对它们进行严格比较。特别注意区分直接肝细胞替代与旁分泌支持和内源性修复刺激，同时将临床前发现与人体研究中获得的证据分开。我们还研究了 MSC 衍生的细胞外囊泡作为一种新兴的无细胞方法，并评估基于类器官的分化、三维封装和可扩展的生物反应器系统如何解决肝细胞成熟和功能稳定性的局限性。重要的是，在评估干细胞来源的肝细胞的治疗潜力时，肝细胞标志物表达与成熟代谢功能不同。通过将这些生物和工程考虑因素与产品异质性、致瘤风险、制造再现性以及经过验证的机制相关效力测定的需要相结合，本综述确定了临床转化的主要障碍。它不是提供治疗平台的描述性目录，而是提供了一个比较框架，用于评估再生机制、功能成熟度和制造限制如何影响基于干细胞的肝再生策略的临床准备情况。

global_hot_topics.title: Gene therapy for epilepsy: From
global_hot_topics.authors: Ruotong Qin; Xiaoge Hu; Wei Jiang; Jing Wang; Mei Zheng; Zhenqiang Zhang; Dongrui Ma
global_hot_topics.abstract: Genetic epilepsy, for which the molecular mechanisms are relatively well defined in numerous monogenic forms, represents an attractive model for the transition from symptomatic seizure control to mechanism‑driven correction. However, gene therapy strategies differ in their mechanisms of action, adaptability to specific mutations and translational maturity, making rational selection of interventions based on variant‑specific functional consequences an important clinical challenge. The present review examined five nucleic acid‑based therapeutic strategies, namely gene supplementation, enhancement of endogenous gene expression, gene silencing, DNA editing and RNA editing, for major causative genes, using mutation‑specific functional consequences [loss‑of‑function (LOF) vs. gain‑of‑function] as the primary framework for therapeutic decision‑making. The mechanisms and suitability of each approach are analysed, and their performance in terms of cell‑type specificity, delivery vectors and safety is evaluated by integrating evidence from animal models, induced pluripotent stem cell‑derived neurons and organoids and clinical trials. The present review also summarised key translational barriers, including vector cargo constraints, blood‑brain barrier penetration, off‑target and immune‑associated risks, therapeutic dosing windows and the timing of developmental intervention. Antisense oligonucleotides and regulatory adeno‑associated viral approaches, supported by mature delivery platforms and manageable safety profiles, have progressed furthest towards clinical validation. Endogenous gene activation strategies, such as CRISPR activation, offer a gene replacement‑free approach for LOF disorders but remain preclinical. DNA and RNA editing, while potentially capable of durable disease modification, require further evidence on delivery efficiency and long‑term homeostatic safety. Gene therapy for genetic epilepsy is undergoing a key transition from proof‑of‑concept studies to individualised clinical application. Future progress will depend on integrating personalised intervention design, multi‑target therapeutic combinations, artificial intelligence‑assisted sequence optimisation and standardised translational models, with the potential to drive a paradigm shift from seizure suppression to mechanistic correction.

global_hot_topics.title: Exploratory serum renal biomarker and eGFR responses to high-protein diets during resistance versus concurrent training in resistance-trained men.
global_hot_topics.journal: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
global_hot_topics.authors: Reza Bagheri; Zohreh Karimi; Hamid Ghobadi; Fatemeh Kazeminasab; Richard B Kreider; Gordon A Ferns; Majid Ghayour-Mobarhan; Hamidreza Malekinezhad
global_hot_topics.abstract: BACKGROUND: High protein intake is common among resistance-trained athletes, but its association with renal biomarkers across different exercise modalities remains uncertain. This study investigated whether consuming a high-protein diet (3.2 g·kg⁻¹·d⁻¹) during 16 weeks of resistance training (RT) or concurrent training (CT) affects renal biomarkers and estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) in resistance-trained men. METHODS: Forty-eight resistance-trained men (26 ± 6 years; BMI 25.6 ± 2.9 kg·m⁻²) were randomized to 16 weeks of RT or CT (4 sessions·wk⁻¹) while consuming either 1.6 or 3.2 g·kg⁻¹·d⁻¹ of protein in a 2 × 2 factorial design. Forty-four participants with complete pre- and post-intervention data were analyzed. Fasting blood samples were assessed for blood urea nitrogen (BUN), BUN/creatinine ratio, cystatin C, and eGFR calculated using the CKD-EPI creatinine (2021), cystatin C (2012), and creatinine-cystatin C (2021) equations. Within-group changes were evaluated using paired t-tests, and factorial effects were assessed using linear mixed-effects models (Time × Training × Protein). RESULTS: No statistically significant Time × Protein or Time × Training × Protein interactions were detected for any renal biomarker or eGFR estimate (all p ≥ 0.182). No significant within-group changes occurred in the 1.6 g·kg⁻¹·d⁻¹ groups (all p > 0.05). In both 3.2 g·kg⁻¹·d⁻¹ groups, BUN and cystatin C increased (all p ≤ 0.017), while eGFR estimates decreased (all p ≤ 0.009). The BUN/creatinine ratio remained unchanged (p ≥ 0.614). However, these within-group findings were descriptive because the corresponding interaction effects were not statistically significant. CONCLUSIONS: In resistance-trained men, 16 weeks of high protein intake did not produce statistically detectable differences in renal biomarker or eGFR changes compared with moderate protein intake, irrespective of training modality. Although modest increases in BUN and cystatin C and small decreases in eGFR estimates were observed within the high-protein groups, these findings were not supported by significant factorial interactions. The limited sample size precludes excluding clinically meaningful differences, warranting further investigation in larger studies.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 背景：高蛋白质摄入量在接受阻力训练的运动员中很常见，但其与不同运动方式的肾脏生物标志物的关系仍不确定。本研究调查了在 16 周的阻力训练 (RT) 或同步训练 (CT) 期间摄入高蛋白饮食 (3.2 g·kg⁻1·d⁻1) 是否会影响进行阻力训练的男性的肾脏生物标志物和估计肾小球滤过率 (eGFR)。方法：48 名接受过阻力训练的男性（26 ± 6 岁；BMI 25.6 ± 2.9 kg·m⁻²）被随机接受 16 周的 RT 或 CT（4 次·周⁻1），同时在 2 × 2 析因设计中摄入 1.6 或 3.2 g·kg⁻1·d⁻1 的蛋白质。对具有完整干预前后数据的 44 名参与者进行了分析。使用 CKD-EPI 肌酐 (2021)、胱抑素 C (2012) 和肌酐-胱抑素 C (2021) 方程评估空腹血样的血尿素氮 (BUN)、BUN/肌酐比、胱抑素 C 和 eGFR。使用配对t检验评估组内变化，并使用线性混合效应模型（时间×训练×蛋白质）评估因子效应。结果：对于任何肾脏生物标志物或 eGFR 估计值，均未检测到具有统计学意义的时间 × 蛋白质或时间 × 训练 × 蛋白质相互作用（所有 p ≥ 0.182）。 1.6 g·kg-1·d-1 组没有发生显着的组内变化（所有 p > 0.05）。在两个 3.2 g·kg-1·d-1 组中，BUN 和胱抑素 C 均增加（所有 p ≤ 0.017），而 eGFR 估计值降低（所有 p ≤ 0.009）。 BUN/肌酐比值保持不变 (p ≥ 0.614)。然而，这些组内研究结果是描述性的，因为相应的相互作用效应在统计上并不显着。结论：在接受阻力训练的男性中，无论训练方式如何，与中等蛋白质摄入量相比，16 周的高蛋白质摄入量在肾脏生物标志物或 eGFR 变化方面并未产生统计学上可检测的差异。尽管在高蛋白组中观察到 BUN 和胱抑素 C 适度增加以及 eGFR 估计值小幅下降，但这些发现并未得到显着因子相互作用的支持。有限的样本量无法排除有临床意义的差异……

medical_news.title: The brain’s hidden fear mechanism may explain anxiety and PTSD
medical_news.abstract: A surprising new discovery suggests that fear may cause the brain to blur the line between danger and safety rather than distinguish them more clearly. By observing brain activity in mice using augmented reality, scientists found that memories of threatening and harmless environments began to overlap, potentially allowing faster responses to danger. This "better safe than sorry" survival mechanism could help explain why people with anxiety or PTSD sometimes experience intense fear in completely safe situations.

medical_news.title: A little-known protein could be a major culprit in type 2 diabetes
medical_news.abstract: Scientists have discovered that a buildup of a protein called Miro1 may be a hidden driver of insulin resistance in Type 2 diabetes, with preclinical experiments showing that removing it restores the muscles’ response to insulin. Exercise was also found to lower Miro1 levels in people with diabetes, revealing a potential new pathway for treating the disease.

medical_news.title: Scientists wipe out deadly brain tumors in every mouse tested with new cancer therapy
medical_news.abstract: Scientists at UC San Francisco have developed a powerful new cancer therapy that remains inactive until it reaches the brain, where it switches on to attack deadly tumors. The engineered immune cells, called B-SYNC CAR-T cells, completely eliminated diffuse midline glioma (DMG), an aggressive childhood brain cancer that is almost always fatal within a year, in two mouse models.

medical_news.title: Scientists discover hidden brain changes linked to common sleep disorders
medical_news.abstract: Scientists have discovered that sleep disorders are associated with structural changes in brain regions that control attention, decision-making, and emotions, potentially explaining why disrupted sleep can affect everyday thinking and behavior. The findings, drawn from 57 brain imaging studies, reveal both shared and disorder-specific patterns that could lead to more targeted treatments.

medical_news.title: Alzheimer’s may have early warning signs outside the brain
medical_news.abstract: A surprising discovery suggests that some early signs of Alzheimer’s disease may begin outside the brain. Using miniature laboratory systems made from human cells, scientists found that genetic mutations associated with inherited Alzheimer’s can disrupt nerve-to-muscle connections without any involvement from the brain or spinal cord. This could help explain why some patients experience changes in balance, walking, and coordination long before memory problems develop.

medical_news.title: Common supplement could help fight psoriasis, scientists discover
medical_news.abstract: Scientists have discovered that pantethine, a readily available vitamin B5 derivative, can calm overactive immune cells and may help fight psoriasis. The supplement prevented psoriasis in mice and showed promising results in a small human trial, revealing an unexpected connection between cholesterol and autoimmune inflammation.

medical_news.title: A simple supplement may help clear brain fog after cancer
medical_news.abstract: A surprising new study from UCLA suggests that a naturally occurring molecule could help breast cancer survivors overcome the frustrating brain fog and exhaustion that can linger long after treatment ends. Researchers found that women taking an oxaloacetate supplement for eight weeks experienced substantial improvements in memory, concentration, mental clarity, and fatigue.
